$comment: The /proyectos screen (t152): one entry per client project, read-only. `board` is the GitHub Project v2 (owner + number) whose Status columns are the stations, `statusOrder` their order on the band (Status names the board has and this list lacks follow at the end), `repos` the repos whose open PRs are listed, `issueRepo` the repo the board's issues live in and `issueKeys` the patterns (one capture group: the issue number in issueRepo) that tie a PR title, branch or body to one of them. Read by src/lib/integrations/projects-config.ts; an untracked config/projects.local.json merged over this file (objects merge by key, arrays and values replace, as config/sweep.local.json does) changes it for one machine. Mesa never writes to these repos or boards.
